resources.string: A multiplier on top of the volume set in the profile. The app never changes your system volume — the alarm slider stays yours.
Background music dips for the length of the cue and comes back on its own. Off — the cue plays over the music without touching it.
Off by default: the synthesiser stresses Sanskrit asana names its own way. Set “Pronunciation” on a stage to fix it, then turn this on.
100% is the engine default. The language follows the app language.
The voice data for this language is not installed — cues will stay silent.
This device has no voice for the app language. Cues configured for voice will fall back to a soft gong.
A ring is a square: on a short screen its diameter runs out of height before it runs out of width. A panel takes the full width — on a small phone the digits come out about half again as large.
During a session only. The countdown does not depend on it: it keeps running with the screen off.
After 15 seconds without a touch the screen dims but stays readable. Any touch or a stage change brings the brightness back.
A settings button on the session screen. Leaving for it does not interrupt the class: the countdown is held by the background service.
During a class the mode switches by tapping the pause bar. Here you choose the one a pause starts with.
The whole class: time stands still
The stage only: class time keeps running
Material You palette. Never applied to the session screen — it does not guarantee contrast.
One-off advice about battery optimisation and exact alarms is shown once and then hidden for good.
The app is free and has no ads. If it helps you teach, you can support its development.
Stages, durations and cues — your whole plan. After that you only press Start: the app runs it for you.
A gong entering the pose, a voice a minute before the end, silence in savasana. You lead the room, not the timer.
Tell the app how much time you have. It counts the remainder by the clock, warns you before the class ends, and trims the plan if the group ran long.
Screen off, app in the background, a call mid-practice — the countdown goes on. The digits read from across the room.
